motto: Serbisyo sa Mamamayan, Malasakit Para sa Bayan
overview: Welcome to the official portal of Tanza, Cavite (Heart of the Cavite Coast). Tanza is a 1st class municipality with a population of 339,308 (2024 Census) and 41 barangays. Historic site where Emilio Aguinaldo took his oath of office as Philippine Revolutionary President in 1897.

mayor.name: Hon. Archangelo B. Matro
mayor.message: Welcome to the dedicated portal of Tanza Municipality. We provide transparent, ARTA and DILG compliant public services for every Tanzeño.
